profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dawn Foods
profile.summary:
Frontend Developer with over 4 years of experience building and maintaining sophisticated websites and internal frameworks, with a focus on React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Redux.

I have experience working with technologies like Contentstack and Algolia. I've used Contentstack, a headless CMS, to support scalable, adaptable applications. My expertise enables smooth integrations that ensure an optimal user experience.

I have contributed to the end-to-end implementation of a BlueSnap payment gateway for an eCommerce platform, creating a secure and efficient payment process. By collaborating closely with back-end developers and designers, I helped build a seamless, user-friendly checkout experience that meets industry standards for security and performance.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description: Full-time immersive program in full-stack web development. Gained hands on experience with the latest front-end and back-end programming languages, tools, and methodologies including: HTML, CSS, Javascript, React, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Express, NodeJS, Ruby, Ruby on Rails , Git, and Github.
